primaryChecks.text: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Jephthah said to them, “I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you didn’t save me out of their hand.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The LORD’s angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, “See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive and bear a son.

primaryChecks.text: The LORD’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father. He judged Israel twenty years.

The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!” They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears—behold, the silver is with me. I took it.” His mother said, “May the LORD bless my son!”
primaryChecks.nextContext: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite; so they went over there and said to him, “Who brought you here? What do you do in this place? What do you have here?”

primaryChecks.text: They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol; and their brothers asked them, “What do you say?”
primaryChecks.previousContext: The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.
primaryChecks.nextContext: They said, “Arise, and let’s go up against them; for we have seen the land, and behold, it is very good. Do you stand still? Don’t be slothful to go and to enter in to possess the land.

primaryChecks.text: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.
primaryChecks.nextContext: They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind Kiriath Jearim.
